summary: The authors deposited full and significant-only DESeq2 results for 17 comparisons. Their code and both result lists identify six female age contrasts. None compares whole hypothalamus at PND37 with female PND22, the HypoExplorer baseline.

manualReview.summary: Author DESeq2 results cover six female age contrasts. The registered PND37 versus PND22 contrast is absent.
manualReview.note: Sokolowski et al. profiled individual C57BL/6J hypothalami by bulk 3′-UTR sequencing across five ages in both sexes. The Figshare Figure 2 script fits each pair separately and sets the control as the DESeq2 reference. In females it compares PND22 with PND12, PND27 with PND22, PND32 with PND27, PND37 with PND32, PND32 with PND22 and PND37 with PND27 (case followed by baseline). The full and selected RData lists confirm the code-defined pairs. The matching Zenodo and GitHub app objects carry placeholder raw P values. The Figshare full results contain DESeq2 pvalue and padj fields for the other contrasts. HypoExplorer fits edgeR-QL to five female PND37 mice against five female PND22 mice. The public sources yield no paired gene effects, P values or FDRs for that endpoint.
reviewFlags: The registered PMID describes the companion pituitary experiment. The hypothalamus publication is PMID 39449090.
Expression trajectories, cell-proportion tests and age-by-sex component scores have different estimands from the female whole-tissue endpoint.

evidenceLinks.label: Figure code, full DESeq2 results and selected results

verificationReview.reason: The deposited Figure 2 control/case vectors, full DESeq2 list, significant-only list and volcano plots cover the same age and sex comparisons. The female PND37 fits use PND32 or PND27 as baseline. The female PND22-baseline fits end at PND27 or PND32. Every registered library maps to the hypothalamus deposit, but these age pairs estimate different biological changes. The main and supplementary figures, preprint and archived Shiny data supply no direct gene-level effect for female PND37 relative to PND22. Author concordance, raw P and FDR agreement for that contrast remain unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen when an author-issued gene-level result explicitly identifies the female whole-hypothalamus PND37 versus PND22 libraries, orientation and effect definition. A labelled selected-gene result would reopen only those genes.
